description: Create an audience from one or more existing segments. Audiences are the delivery payload — they have no subtype. To create filter or matched cohorts, use create_segment instead. Accepts segment_refs: [{segment_id, role: include|exclude}] to compose the audience with per-segment inclusion/exclusion control. set_logic controls how include-role segments are combined (union or intersection). Returns audience_id, status and campaign_id immediately. Use record_count only for a verified count of this exact composition. Optional campaign_id links the new audience to that campaign (an audience belongs to at most one); omit it to leave the audience unlinked — link it later with link_audience_to_campaign. Requires 'creator' scope.

campaign_id.description: Optional campaign to link the new audience to (see list_campaigns). An unknown ID is rejected with INVALID_CAMPAIGN_ID and nothing is created.

record_count.description: Legacy caller-provided count for this exact composition. Prefer omitting it and calling recount_audience. The server may reuse a valid saved member count; otherwise record_count is null

segment_refs.description: Array of segment references with roles. Must include at least one include-role segment.

role.description: 'include' to add records from this segment; 'exclude' to subtract them

segment_id.description: The segment ID to include or exclude

set_logic.description: How include-role segments are combined: 'union' (OR, default) or 'intersection' (AND)

name: create_audience

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions

record_count.description: Saved composition count; null is unknown. Use recount_audience for a current value.

set_logic.description: How included segments combine; excluded segments always subtract

title: Create Audience
